purpose: The SGP4 verification set published with Vallado, Crawford, Hujsak and Kelso, 'Revisiting Spacetrack Report #3' (AIAA 2006-6753): 33 test cases (SGP4-VER.TLE) and the reference output of Vallado's C++ implementation (tcppver.out), TEME position in km and velocity in km/s at the stated minutes since the epoch. Unmodified copies; satellites.test.js is held to them.
obtained_from: The sgp4 Python package 2.27 (Brandon Rhodes, MIT licence), which ships both files as test data for its own suite. They were not downloaded from CelesTrak, whose copy was unreachable when this was captured, so byte-for-byte agreement with CelesTrak's copy is not established here.
